name: Workbook
remarks: The Workbook object is a member of the Workbooks collection. The Workbooks collection contains all the Workbook objects currently open in Microsoft Excel. The ThisWorkbook property of the Application object returns the workbook where the Visual Basic code is running. In most cases, this is the same as the active workbook. However, if the Visual Basic code is part of an add-in, the ThisWorkbook property won't return the active workbook. In this case, the active workbook is the workbook calling the add-in, whereas the ThisWorkbook property returns the add-in workbook. If you are creating an add-in from your Visual Basic code, you should use the ThisWorkbook property to qualify any statement that must be run on the workbook that you compile into the add-in.

methods.description: Changes a link from one document to another.

parameters.name: Name

parameters.name: NewName

parameters.name: Type

methods.name: Close
methods.signature: Close([SaveChanges As Variant], [Filename As Variant], [RouteWorkbook As Variant])
methods.description: Closes the object.

parameters.name: SaveChanges
parameters.description: If there are no changes to the workbook, this argument is ignored. If there are changes to the workbook and the workbook appears in other open windows, this argument is ignored. If there are changes to the workbook but the workbook doesn't appear in any other open windows, this argument specifies whether changes should be saved. If set to True, changes are saved to the workbook. If there is not yet a file name associated with the workbook, _FileName_ is used. If _FileName_ is omitted, the user is asked to supply a file name.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: Saves changes under this file name.

parameters.name: RouteWorkbook
parameters.description: If the workbook doesn't need to be routed to the next recipient (if it has no routing slip or has already been routed), this argument is ignored. Otherwise, Microsoft Excel routes the workbook according to the value of this parameter. If set to True, the workbook is sent to the next recipient. If set to False, the workbook is not sent. If omitted, the user is asked whether the workbook should be sent.

methods.name: CheckIn

methods.description: Returns a workbook from a local computer to a server, and sets the local workbook to read-only so that it cannot be edited locally. Calling this method will also close the workbook.

parameters.description: True saves changes and checks in the document. False returns the document to a checked-in status without saving revisions.

parameters.name: MakePublic

This submits the workbook for the approval process, which can eventually result in a version of the workbook being published to users with read-only rights to the workbook (applies only if _SaveChanges_ equals True).

methods.name: SendForReview
methods.signature: SendForReview([Recipients As Variant], [Subject As Variant], [ShowMessage As Variant], [IncludeAttachment As Variant])
methods.description: Sends a workbook in an email message for review to the specified recipients.

parameters.name: Recipients
parameters.description: A string that lists the people to whom to send the message. These can be unresolved names and aliases in an email phone book or full email addresses. Separate multiple recipients with a semicolon (;). If left blank and _ShowMessage_ is False, you'll receive an error message, and the message will not be sent.

parameters.name: Subject
parameters.description: A string for the subject of the message. If left blank, the subject will be: Please review "filename".

parameters.name: ShowMessage
parameters.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the message should be displayed when the method is executed. The default value is True. If set to False, the message is automatically sent to the recipients without first showing the message to the sender.

parameters.name: IncludeAttachment
parameters.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the message should include an attachment or a link to a server location. The default value is True. If set to False, the document must be stored at a shared location.

methods.name: ReplyWithChanges
methods.description: Sends an email message to the author of a workbook that has been sent out for review, notifying them that a reviewer has completed review of the workbook.

parameters.name: ShowMessage
parameters.description: False does not display the message. True displays the message.

methods.name: EndReview
methods.description: Terminates a review of a file that has been sent for review by using the SendForReview method.

methods.signature: SetPasswordEncryptionOptions([PasswordEncryptionProvider As Variant], [PasswordEncryptionAlgorithm As Variant], [PasswordEncryptionKeyLength As Variant], [PasswordEncryptionFileProperties As Variant])
methods.description: Sets the options for encrypting workbooks by using passwords.

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionProvider

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionAlgorithm
parameters.description: A case-sensitive string of the algorithmic short name (that is, "RC4").

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionKeyLength

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionFileProperties
parameters.description: True (default) to encrypt file properties.

methods.name: Protect
methods.signature: Protect([Password As Variant], [Structure As Variant], [Windows As Variant])
methods.description: Protects a workbook so that it cannot be modified.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: A string that specifies a case-sensitive password for the worksheet or workbook. If this argument is omitted, you can unprotect the worksheet or workbook without using a password. Otherwise, you must specify the password to unprotect the worksheet or workbook. If you forget the password, you cannot unprotect the worksheet or workbook. Use strong passwords that combine uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Weak passwords don't mix these elements. Strong password: Y6dh!et5. Weak password: House27. Passwords should be 8 or more characters in length. A pass phrase that uses 14 or more characters is better. It's critical that you remember your password. If you forget your password, Microsoft cannot retrieve it. Store the passwords that you write down in a secure place away from the information that they help protect.

parameters.name: Structure
parameters.description: True to protect the structure of the workbook (the relative position of the sheets). The default value is False.

parameters.name: Windows
parameters.description: True to protect the workbook windows. If this argument is omitted, the windows aren't protected.

methods.name: SendFaxOverInternet
methods.signature: SendFaxOverInternet([Recipients As Variant], [Subject As Variant], [ShowMessage As Variant])
methods.description: Sends a worksheet as a fax to the specified recipients.

parameters.name: Recipients
parameters.description: A String that represents the fax numbers and email addresses of the people to whom the fax will be sent. Separate multiple recipients with a semicolon.

parameters.name: Subject
parameters.description: A String that represents the subject line for the faxed document.

parameters.name: ShowMessage
parameters.description: True displays the fax message before sending it. False sends the fax without displaying the fax message.

methods.name: XmlImport
methods.signature: XmlImport(Url As String, ImportMap As XmlMap, [Overwrite As Variant], [Destination As Variant]) As XlXmlImportResult
methods.description: Imports an XML data file into the current workbook.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: A uniform resource locator (URL) or a uniform naming convention (UNC) path to an XML data file.

parameters.name: ImportMap
parameters.description: The schema map to apply when importing the file. If the data was previously imported, contains a reference to the XmlMap object containing the data.

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: If a value is not specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite data that has been mapped to the schema map specified in the _ImportMap_ parameter. Set to True to overwrite the data or False to append the new data to the existing data. The default value is True. If a value is specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite existing data. Set to True to overwrite existing data or False to cancel the import if data would be overwritten. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Specifies the range where the list will be created. You only use the top-left corner of the range.

methods.name: XmlImportXml
methods.signature: XmlImportXml(Data As String, ImportMap As XmlMap, [Overwrite As Variant], [Destination As Variant]) As XlXmlImportResult

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: The data to import.

parameters.name: ImportMap

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: If a value is not specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite data that has been mapped to the schema map specified in the _ImportMap_ parameter. Set to True to overwrite the data or False to append the new data to the existing data. The default value is True. If a value is specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite existing data. Set to True to overwrite existing data or False to cancel the import if data would be overwritten. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Specifies the range where the list will be created. Excel only uses the top-left corner of the range.

methods.name: SaveAs
methods.signature: SaveAs([Filename As Variant], [FileFormat As Variant], [Password As Variant], [WriteResPassword As Variant], [ReadOnlyRecommended As Variant], [CreateBackup As Variant], [AccessMode As XlSaveAsAccessMode], [ConflictResolution As Variant], [AddToMru As Variant], [TextCodepage As Variant], [TextVisualLayout As Variant], [Local As Variant], [WorkIdentity As Variant])
methods.description: Saves changes to the workbook in a different file.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: A string that indicates the name of the file to be saved. You can include a full path; if you don't, Microsoft Excel saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: FileFormat
parameters.description: The file format to use when you save the file. For a list of valid choices, see the XlFileFormat enumeration. For an existing file, the default format is the last file format specified; for a new file, the default is the format of the version of Excel being used.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: A case-sensitive string (no more than 15 characters) that indicates the protection password to be given to the file.

parameters.name: WriteResPassword
parameters.description: A string that indicates the write-reservation password for this file. If a file is saved with the password and the password isn't supplied when the file is opened, the file is opened as read-only.

parameters.name: ReadOnlyRecommended
parameters.description: True to display a message when the file is opened, recommending that the file be opened as read-only.

parameters.name: CreateBackup
parameters.description: True to create a backup file.

parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description: The access mode for the workbook.

parameters.name: ConflictResolution
parameters.description: An XlSaveConflictResolution value that determines how the method resolves a conflict while saving the workbook. If set to xlUserResolution, the conflict-resolution dialog box is displayed. If set to xlLocalSessionChanges, the local user's changes are automatically accepted. If set to xlOtherSessionChanges, the changes from other sessions are automatically accepted instead of the local user's changes. If this argument is omitted, the conflict-resolution dialog box is displayed.

parameters.name: AddToMru
parameters.description: True to add this workbook to the list of recently used files. The default value is False.

parameters.name: TextCodepage
parameters.description: Ignored for all languages in Microsoft Excel. NOTE: When Excel saves a workbook to one of the CSV or text formats, which are specified by using the _FileFormat_ parameter, it uses the code page that corresponds to the language for the system locale in use on the current computer. This system setting is available in the Control Panel > Region and Language > Location tab under Current location.

parameters.name: TextVisualLayout
parameters.description: Ignored for all languages in Microsoft Excel. NOTE: When Excel saves a workbook to one of the CSV or text formats, which are specified by using the _FileFormat_ parameter, it saves these formats in logical layout. If left-to-right (LTR) text is embedded within right-to-left (RTL) text in the file, or vice versa, logical layout saves the contents of the file in the correct reading order for all languages in the file without regard to direction. When an application opens the file, each run of LTR or RTL characters are rendered in the correct direction according to the character value ranges within the code page (unless an application that is designed to display the exact memory layout of the file, such as a debugger or editor, is used to open the file).

parameters.name: Local
parameters.description: True saves files against the language of Microsoft Excel (including control panel settings). False (default) saves files against the language of Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) (which is typically US English unless the VBA project where Workbooks.Open is run from is an old internationalized XL5/95 VBA project).

methods.name: ExportAsFixedFormat
methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat(Type As XlFixedFormatType, [Filename As Variant], [Quality As Variant], [IncludeDocProperties As Variant], [IgnorePrintAreas As Variant], [From As Variant], [To As Variant], [OpenAfterPublish As Variant], [FixedFormatExtClassPtr As Variant], [WorkIdentity As Variant])
methods.description: The ExportAsFixedFormat method is used to publish a workbook to either the PDF or XPS format.

parameters.description: Can be either xlTypePDF or xlTypeXPS.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: A string that indicates the name of the file to be saved. You can include a full path, or Excel saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Can be set to either of the following XlFixedFormatQuality constants: xlQualityStandard or xlQualityMinimum.

parameters.name: IncludeDocProperties
parameters.description: Set to True to indicate that document properties should be included, or set to False to indicate that they are omitted.

parameters.name: IgnorePrintAreas
parameters.description: If set to True, ignores any print areas set when publishing. If set to False, uses the print areas set when publishing.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the page at which to start publishing. If this argument is omitted, publishing starts at the beginning.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last page to publish. If this argument is omitted, publishing ends with the last page.

parameters.name: OpenAfterPublish
parameters.description: If set to True, displays the file in the viewer after it is published. If set to False, the file is published but not displayed.

parameters.name: FixedFormatExtClassPtr
parameters.description: Pointer to the FixedFormatExt class.

events.name: SheetPivotTableBeforeDiscardChanges
events.signature: SheetPivotTableBeforeDiscardChanges(Sh As Object, TargetPivotTable As PivotTable, ValueChangeStart As Long, ValueChangeEnd As Long)
events.description: Occurs before changes to a PivotTable are discarded.

parameters.name: Sh
parameters.description: The worksheet that contains the PivotTable.

parameters.name: TargetPivotTable
parameters.description: The PivotTable that contains the changes to discard.

parameters.name: ValueChangeStart
parameters.description: The index to the first change in the associated PivotTableChangeList object. The index is specified by the Order property of the ValueChange object in the PivotTableChangeList collection.

parameters.name: ValueChangeEnd
parameters.description: The index to the last change in the associated PivotTableChangeList object. The index is specified by the Order property of the ValueChange object in the PivotTableChangeList collection.

events.name: SheetPivotTableChangeSync
events.signature: SheetPivotTableChangeSync(Sh As Object, Target As PivotTable)
events.description: Occurs after changes to a PivotTable.

parameters.name: Sh
parameters.description: The worksheet that contains the PivotTable.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The PivotTable that was changed.

events.name: AfterSave
events.description: Occurs after the workbook is saved.

parameters.name: Success
parameters.description: True if the save operation was successful; False otherwise.

events.name: NewChart
events.description: Occurs when a new chart is created in the workbook.

parameters.name: Ch
parameters.description: The new chart.

events.name: SheetLensGalleryRenderComplete
events.description: Occurs when a callout gallery's icons (dynamic and static) have completed rendering for a worksheet.

parameters.name: Sh
parameters.description: A worksheet object.

events.name: SheetTableUpdate
events.signature: SheetTableUpdate(Sh As Object, Target As TableObject)
events.description: Occurs after the sheet table has been updated.

parameters.name: Sh
parameters.description: The selected sheet.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The selected table.

events.name: ModelChange
events.description: Occurs after the Excel data model is changed.

parameters.name: Changes
parameters.description: ModelChanges object that includes changes made to the Excel data model during the last transaction.

events.name: SheetBeforeDelete
events.description: Occurs when any sheet is deleted.

parameters.name: Sh
parameters.description: The sheet. Can be a Chart or Worksheet object.

events.name: BeforeRemoteChange
events.description: Occurs before a remote user's edits to the workbook are merged.

events.name: AfterRemoteChange
events.description: Occurs after a remote user's edits to the workbook are merged.
